# CV Builder — Bahrul Bangsawan

> Free bilingual (English / Bahasa Indonesia) online CV and resume builder with real-time preview, ATS-friendly templates, and one-click PDF export. Runs in the browser, no sign-up.

## Pages

- [CV Builder (English)](https://cv.bahrul.me): Build, preview, and download an ATS-friendly resume as PDF with live preview and four templates (basic, Harvard, simple, standard).
- [Pembuat CV (Bahasa Indonesia)](https://cv.bahrul.me/id): Indonesian-language version of the CV builder with the same templates, real-time preview, and PDF export.

## Key Facts

- Free to use; no account or sign-up required
- Bilingual: English (default, /) and Bahasa Indonesia (/id)
- Exports print-faithful PDF resumes rendered in the browser
- ATS-friendly templates: basic, Harvard, simple, standard
- Privacy-friendly: resume data stays in your browser
- Built by Bahrul Bangsawan
